name: Psychic Wave AP OLD
description: A wave of psychic energy ripples through the room, violently prying into the minds of creatures in the area and alerting Kemnebi to the presence of intruders.
disable: DC 50 Arcana (legendary) to stymie the psychic energy before it manifests

generalAbilities.name: Psychic Assault
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature has been in the room for more than 1 round

Effect A wave of psychic energy slams into the minds of creatures in the chamber, dealing (8d10+48) Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 44 Will Saving Throw). On a failed save, a creature is also Stunned 3.
